name: search
title: Search library
description: Cross-entry search across the library. Searches items (papers/books), annotations (highlights with your comments), and notes. mode=relevance (default) ranks by BM25 and returns matching passages; mode=grep scans for a literal pattern without tokenization and returns every hit with line/offset positions. Use filters to narrow scope; use depth=full only when snippets are not enough.

query.description: Search query for mode=relevance. Plain keywords or phrases.

depth.description: ids: metadata only. snippets: matching passages per result (default). full: full text of each result, truncated to the token budget. In mode=grep: ids returns matchCount only, snippets returns hit windows, full still fetches each document's text.

snippetsPerResult.description: Number of passages per result when depth=snippets. In mode=grep, the maximum number of hit windows per document.

colors.description: Annotation highlight colors. Only applies to target=annotations.

filters.description: Filters not applicable to a target are silently ignored.

k.description: Max results per target. In mode=grep, the maximum number of documents.

mode.description: relevance: BM25 ranking (default). grep: literal scan without tokenization or ranking; returns every occurrence of pattern with line/offset positions.

pattern.description: Literal string to scan for in mode=grep. Matched verbatim (no tokenization, stemming, or stop words). Required when mode=grep; ignored when mode=relevance.

caseSensitive.description: mode=grep only: match case-sensitively. Folding is ASCII-only; non-ASCII case pairs are never folded.

wholeWord.description: mode=grep only: report a hit only when it is not adjacent to [A-Za-z0-9_].

maxMatches.description: mode=grep only: stop scanning after this many hits in total; the response is marked truncated when it is reached.
